utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me? Teams has picked the wrong microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, you're coming through. I was just looking at the weather for the weekend. Had plans for a walk, but apparently we're getting properly soaked.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: We got that this morning. Traffic on the ring road was barely moving. Twenty minutes looking at the same van.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. A scenic tour, without the scenery.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And now the heating in the portakabin is roasting me. Not asking anyone to fix it, before that becomes a job. Just having a moan.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's your temperature compensation. Cold outside, tropical inside.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, Tuesday, sixth of October. Let's get through the actual list before we lose everyone to the portakabin sauna.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: First, I finished the repair on the trucks last night. That's done, not something we're carrying into today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the 11kV board yesterday. That one's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Those were still showing in the chat history, so worth saying they're closed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same for mine: finished the repair on the line 1 mould temp last night. All done.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Cheers. Three completed bits, then, no repeat jobs there.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Just an observation from me. Heard a slight rattle from the Line 3 Screw and Barrel, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, and I heard a slight rattle from the line 1 hydraulics. Same thing, nothing to action yet. Just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood. Observations only, neither of those is becoming a new job this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The other thing, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the main water valve. That's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no confirmed delivery against it. Still a blocker, not fresh work for today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the PRV on the boiler, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fine, that replacement is off this round. Right, onto what we are agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll inspect the MV01 for leaks today. I'll take that one myself.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just the leak inspection, yeah? Not agreeing a replacement off the back of the old note?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Inspect the MV01 for leaks today, nothing beyond that being agreed here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got it, Priya Raman against that inspection today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Aisha, can you take vibration readings on the feedwater pump tomorrow at 9:30? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped slightly. Tomorrow at 9:30, not this morning?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, yes. And that is top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, accepted. I'll take vibration readings on the feedwater pump tomorrow at 9:30. Top of my list.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I heard this morning as well, to be fair. The audio went all underwater.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Good, not just me needing another coffee, then.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Tom, can you update the risk assessment for work on the waste heat boiler by Thursday? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. We're talking the risk assessment for the work, not rewriting the whole operating document?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's right, the risk assessment for work on the waste heat boiler. Keeping it to that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, I'll update that risk assessment by Thursday. Understood on top priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Thursday for that, and tomorrow at 9:30 for the readings. Two separate dates; I've got them straight now.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, exactly. Both with the priority we've just said.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sarah Okafor, can you write up the near miss at the line two for Monday? It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I can't take that on, sorry. I haven't got the capacity to give the write-up proper attention. Better to say no now.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay. Marcus, can I hand that to you instead? Write up the near miss at the line two for Monday. Still fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead. I'll write up the near miss at the line two for Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Sorry to bounce it, but I don't want my name against something I can't do.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, fair enough. I've already got my notes from it, so I'm not starting with a blank page.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus. That's yours, then, for Monday, and fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, on Northfield, I'll do a site visit at Northfield with the contractor on Friday. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Friday, with the contractor. And low priority, rather than being pulled forward?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll do the site visit at Northfield with the contractor on Friday. It stays low priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks, Olumide Adeyemi. Agreed as you've said it: on Friday, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Take the portakabin weather with you. You'll have sunshine all day.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Think that's just the heater and a fluorescent tube, mate.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team this afternoon as well. That's in the 'if you've got a spare minute' category, not another top-priority one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. Yes, if you've got a spare minute; we're not giving that the same urgency as the readings.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep. I'll organise it this afternoon on that basis. Just keeping the urgency clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine by me. No need to turn everything into a red flag.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: There's also the pressure drop on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve. That needs investigating, normal priority. Anyone able to take it?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can't take that investigation as well, sorry. Don't put it against me.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can't commit to that one either. Don't want a vague 'I'll have a look' turning into ownership.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same here, no capacity for that on top. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. Investigate the pressure drop on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve stays unassigned, normal priority. No owner and no date agreed.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes, unallocated. Not tucked under somebody else's name.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, that's the list. Anything we've just discussed that I've misunderstood? Not opening a second list, mind.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, all clear. And we nearly managed that without everyone talking over—

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: —each other. Sorry! No, nothing from me. Back to deciding whether my weekend walk needs a canoe.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll be here slowly turning into a baked potato. Again, commentary, not a maintenance request.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Very clearly recorded as a moan. Cheers, everyone, we'll leave it there.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers. Bye.
